mapper.sql: biz50_erp_setup_id AS erp_setup_id , biz50_start_date AS start_date , biz50_sms_base_count AS sms_base_count , biz50_sms_add_price AS sms_add_price , biz50_server_base_usage AS server_base_usage , biz50_server_add_unit AS server_add_unit , biz50_server_add_price AS server_add_price , biz50_charge_day AS charge_day , biz50_vat_cd AS vat_cd , biz50_user_base_count AS user_base_count , biz50_user_add_price AS user_add_price , biz50_deposit_due_day AS deposit_due_day
mapper.select: SELECT , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_charge_day, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS charge_day_str , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_deposit_due_day, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS deposit_due_day_str , f_cdnm('VatCode', biz50_vat_cd, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS vat_nm FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE biz50_note_yn != 'true' ORDER BY biz50_start_date DESC

SELECT , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_charge_day, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS charge_day_str , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_deposit_due_day, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS deposit_due_day_str , f_cdnm('VatCode', biz50_vat_cd, #{companyId}, biz50_start_date) AS vat_nm FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE biz50_note_yn != 'true' AND biz50_start_date <= #{stdDate} ORDER BY ABS(biz50_start_date - #{stdDate}) LIMIT 1

SELECT , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_charge_day, 0, biz50_start_date) AS charge_day_str , f_cdnm('DateCode', biz50_deposit_due_day, 0, biz50_start_date) AS deposit_due_day_str , f_cdnm('VatCode', biz50_vat_cd, 0, biz50_start_date) AS vat_nm FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE biz50_erp_setup_id = #{erpSetupId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE biz50_erp_setup_id = #{erpSetupId}
SELECT biz50_note FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE biz50_note_yn = 'true' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: WITH upsert AS ( UPDATE biz50_erp_setup SET biz50_note = #{note} WHERE biz50_note_yn = 'true' RETURNING * ) INSERT INTO biz50_erp_setup ( biz50_erp_setup_id, biz50_note, biz50_note_yn ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{note}, 'true' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM upsert )
mapper.select: SELECT biz50_erp_setup_id AS erp_setup_id , biz50_mail_form AS mail_form FROM biz50_erp_setup WHERE COALESCE(biz50_note_yn, 'false') = 'false' AND biz50_start_date IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz50_erp_setup ( biz50_erp_setup_id, biz50_mail_form ) VALUES ( #{erpSetupId}, #{mailForm} )
